description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange w.e.f. 10.07.2017 to 16.07.2017
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters. While it names an Acting Director General, this is only to establish the authority issuing the regulation, not to announce a personnel change or assign portfolio responsibilities.
